delivery.title: Imininingwana yokudiliva - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Ukudlulisa" lapha kutjho kwaphela bona iseva ehlosiweko ibuyise ubujamo be HTTP 2xx - akuqinisekisi bona ihlelo elamukelako lilondoloze namkha lisebenze umrholi. Hlola umzimba wependulo ongehla bona uthini kwamambala; nangabe ayinalitho nofana ukuvuma nje, ihlelo lelo lingathola isibawo kodwana liyala nofana lingatjheji umthwalo ngaphakathi (amagama/efomethi engakalungi ye API yayo, indawo etlhogekako ehlangothini layo umthwalo lo ongafaki, njll).

push.title: Webhooks aphumako - ama-Phush Leads & Updates
push.intro: Ilungiswa ngokuzeleko nge- webhook : JSON , iFomu (x-www-form-urlencoded), nofana ithempulethi yakho yomzimba we-Custom ene- <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (isib <example></example> ) - isebenza njengokuzalisa umyalo cURL kanye.
push.curlLabel: Namathisela cURL yeklayenti lakho le CRM
push.curlHelp: Namathisela isibawo sesibonelo amadokhumenti wabo API nofana Postman akunikela wona (ngedatha yamambala nofana isampula). URL , indlela kanye neenhloko zikopishwa njengombana zinjalo, begodu woke amakhiye emzimbeni ahlelwe ngenzasi ukwenzela bona ukhethe bona ngiyiphi insimu CRM ezoyigcwalisa umrholi ngamunye.
push.curlPrompt: Ingabe unayo cURL yeklayenti? <action>Ngenisa kusuka cURL</action> ukuzalisa lokhu begodu umebhe amasimu ngokuzenzakalelako.
push.urlVariables: I URL nayo ingaba namatjhuguluko, isib. <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Iinhloko kufanele zibe yi JSON efaneleko, isib. {{example}}
push.authTitle: Ukuqinisekiswa (ukuthi Leadrat ingena njani ku API yabo)
push.modeSame: Thumela yoke iminyanya ku URL efanako
push.modeCreateUpdate: Yenza irekhodi kanye, bese uvuselela irekhodi elifanako (akukho ukuphindaphinda ohlangothini lwabo)
push.responseIdHint: Lapho i ID ikhona khona ipendulo yabo JSON yesibawo sokudala. Ilondolozwe nge-lead ngayinye njenge- <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Ukuphumula kwesikhathi, amaphutha HTTP 429 kanye ne-5xx - ngemva kwemizuzu emi-1, imizuzu emi-5, imizuzu ema-30, i-2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Indlela amagugu azaliswa ngayo: webhook le isetjenziselwa godu kiwo woke umdosiphambili - Leadrat ayithumeli isibonelo esijameleko, ithumela ukusunduza okutjha ngaso soke isikhathi nakwenzeka umcimbi okhethiweko, ngamanani wamanje womdosiphambili loyo.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Ifomu ifaka hlangana yoke imikhakha emthonjeni - akukho okufanele ukuhlele.
push.howFilledCustom: Ngokwezifiso - tlola umzimba wakho wesicelo bese ufaka nanyana kukuphi; ngayinye itjhugululwa ngenani lamambala le-lead ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Chofoza into engezansi ukuyifaka.
push.rawTemplate: Isifanekiso somzimba (esihlaza) - hlela ngqo nofana ufake amatjhuguluko
push.previewEmpty: (tlola isifanekiso somzimba ngehla ukubona ukubukwa ngaphambilini)
push.deleteConfirm: Susa i webhook " {{name}} "? Lokhu angeze kwabuyiselwa emuva.

api.title: API yakho - Ukufikelela ngeendlela ezimbili kiyo nanyana ngiyiphi isistimu
api.intro: Nanyana ngiliphi ihlelo elinekhiye lakho le API lingenza, lifunde begodu libuyekeze ama-lead begodu libhalise emicimbini yama-lead. Thumela ikhiye ku- <hdr></hdr> ihloko, njenge- <bearer></bearer> , nofana (nangabe ithulusi lingakghoni ukubeka iinhloko) njenge- <query></query> . Umkhawulo: {{limit}} weenbawo ngomzuzu.
api.noPermission: Ngumuntu onemvumo yokuphatha amasethingi kwaphela ongabuka ikhi API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa ikhiye le nje bese uyibeka endaweni ephephileko - ukuvikeleka itjengiswa kanye kwaphela. Nayilahlekile, yenza enye etja.
api.regenerateConfirm: Yenza ikhi ye API etja? Ikhiye yamanje iyajama ukusebenza khonokho kiwo woke amasistimu ayisebenzisako.
api.openApiHint: Ngenisa i OpenAPI spec ku- Postman , Zapier , Make nofana n8n ukwenza woke ama-endpoint alungele ukusetjenziswa.
